description: This file defines a class 'GoogleCalendarEventInputPipe' that transforms input data into a format suitable for Google Calendar API updates, including handling attendees, event status, and date-time zones.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarEventInputPipe
classes.description: A class implementing transformation logic for Google Calendar event input data, converting it into API-compatible payloads.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms input data into a Google Calendar API payload, mapping fields like title, description, start/end times, attendees, and status.

methods.name: transformDateTimeWithZone
methods.description: Converts a date-time with timezone into Google Calendar's dateTime and timeZone format.

methods.name: transformAttendees
methods.description: Transforms attendee data into Google Calendar attendee objects, including email, displayName, responseStatus, and roles.

methods.name: transformResponseStatus
methods.description: Converts internal response status enums into Google Calendar response status strings.

methods.name: transformEventStatus
methods.description: Converts internal event status enums into Google Calendar event status strings.
